Assistant (0.7s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Ms Nair?

User (2.1s): Yes, that is me.

Assistant (3.0s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (4.3s): seventeen May.

Assistant (5.9s): Thank you. And the year?

User (7.6s): nineteen.

Assistant (9.0s): Thank you. And the year?

User (11.0s): eighty-six.

Assistant (14.3s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (15.5s): fifteen.

Assistant (16.6s): Thank you. And the remaining 2 digits?

User (18.2s): zero two.

Assistant (23.7s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 1903 has a past-due amount of 2125.10, which is 12 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (24.8s): The full amount is too much for me right now.

Assistant (27.2s): I understand, Ms Nair. For your credit card ending 1903, can you pay 637.50 on Wednesday 14 October 2026? The rest of the amount stays overdue.

User (29.8s): You tell me.

Assistant (30.7s): Can you make a payment of 637.50 on Wednesday 14 October 2026, Ms Nair?

User (33.1s): I can do that this Friday.

Assistant (35.7s): To confirm: you will pay 637.50 for the credit card ending 1903 on Friday 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (37.2s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (39.7s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (46.0s): Thank you. Your promise of 637.50 for the credit card ending 1903 on Friday 16 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
